column1: # field_manifest_v1.tsv -- the ClassView-side field manifest for weather-poc
# One row per OCCUPIED byte of the L4 `6x(8:8)` facet layout
# rows (plan §2.5) -- their absence IS their meaning: dormant, expandable
# later without a layout change (RESERVE, DON'T RECLAIM).
# lo/hi convention: within a pair written "A : B" in the plan §2.5 table,
# A is the LOW byte and B is the HIGH byte -- the pair's own left-to-right
# order. Kept consistent across every row below.
# facet: 0 = F0 (surface), 1 = F1 (850 hPa), 2 = F2 (500 hPa) -- plan §2.5.
# variable: the ERA5 variable name exactly as it appears in the Zarr store
# level_hpa: the pressure level in hPa, or the literal token `surface`.
# floor_id: a stable identifier for the calibration floor this field uses;
# two rows sharing a floor_id share the same [lo, hi] calibration (none do
# in this committed manifest -- each field here is calibrated on its own
